product_summary: Social listening and media monitoring platform, now delivered as Agorapulse Listening, with a streaming API that returns keyword mentions from web, news, blogs, forums and social platforms.

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: We use a streaming API, so you’ll receive mentions as soon as they happen online.
Mention’s API shows you when your keywords are used on websites, forums, blogs, the news, and social media.

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched the media monitoring API page, homepage, and Mention/Agorapulse plans documentation for 'newsletter'. No email-newsletter ingestion appears; the documented source list is 'Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, News, Forums, and the Web.'
verified_gap: No newsletter source in Mention's documented monitoring coverage (Web, News, Blogs, Forums, Reddit, social platforms) and no newsletter publication/author metadata or publication momentum signal.

evidence.quote: Mention’s API shows you when your keywords are used on websites, forums, blogs, the news, and social media.
track brand mentions and keywords across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, News, Forums, and the Web
As of July 1, 2026, Mention is no longer sold as a standalone product.

likely_buyer_role: Head of Product / API product manager for Agorapulse Listening (Mention’s successor product)

contact_route.note: No public contact page on mention.com (mention.com/en/contact/ returns 404); only the help center. Mention is no longer sold standalone since July 1, 2026, so outreach should be routed to Agorapulse.

caveats: Gap is well supported but the account is largely retired: Mention stopped standalone sales on 1 July 2026 and its capability is being absorbed into Agorapulse Listening. Its 'News' and 'Blogs' crawlers may surface some newsletter web archives, though no email-newsletter ingestion or publication metadata is documented. No named contact found.
